scope_note: ROBUSTNESS-axis spine for ai-agent-cli, mined via the robustness-surface lens (capability-phrased hardening a mature ai-agent-cli converges on (fix commits)) from ['aider', 'gptme', 'openinterpreter']. Does NOT predict project-specific product direction — that is strategy, not completeness. An axis gates only after beating the generic-baseline control (check.py VALIDATED_GATING_AXES); the rest are advisory.

required.what: Recognizes, hides, and correctly configures currently valid provider model names, versions, capabilities, and deprecations.
required.day1_tell: Start the app with a config containing one current model and one deprecated/removed provider model, then confirm only the valid model is selectable and its advertised capabilities match provider docs.

required.what: Builds API requests with provider- and model-specific fields such as temperature, reasoning levels, max tokens, tools, and streaming delta formats.
required.day1_tell: Send the same prompt to two different providers with tools, temperature, max tokens, reasoning level, and streaming enabled, then inspect captured requests for provider-specific field names and formats.

required.what: Parses heterogeneous chat-completion stream payloads, reasoning deltas, empty fragments, and tool-call formats without corrupting conversation output.
required.day1_tell: Replay recorded streams containing empty deltas, reasoning deltas, normal text, and tool calls from multiple providers, then confirm the final transcript and tool calls are correct.

required.what: Detects and constrains oversized messages, attachments, or completion parameters before they exceed upstream platform limits.
required.day1_tell: Submit an oversized prompt, attachment, and max-token value, then confirm the client rejects or trims them locally before any upstream API call is made.

required.what: Validates and resolves user-controlled paths while rejecting symlink loops, invalid edits, unsafe archives, and malformed path inputs.
required.day1_tell: Attempt edits through a normal path, a symlink loop, path traversal, unsafe archive entry, and malformed path, then confirm only the normal path is accepted.

required.what: Creates required history directories, loads conversations safely, and surfaces dataless or failed loads without crashing.
required.day1_tell: Launch with no history directory, then with a corrupt or empty conversation file, and confirm directories are created and load failures are shown without crashing.

required.what: Preserves command-output formatting, buffers partial reasoning or stream output correctly, and avoids duplicate or lost display text.
required.day1_tell: Stream command output with ANSI formatting, partial chunks, and repeated reasoning fragments, then confirm display text is formatted once with no missing or duplicated chunks.

required.what: Handles user interrupts, turn cancellation, review cancellation, and process termination without hangs, wedges, or lost output.
required.day1_tell: Start a long tool execution or model stream, trigger user cancel and SIGINT, then confirm control returns promptly with partial output preserved.

required.what: Responds to shutdown signals and lifecycle exits by closing servers, streams, locks, and subprocesses cleanly.
required.day1_tell: Start servers, streams, locks, and a subprocess, send a shutdown signal, then confirm all handles close and no child processes remain.

required.what: Reports unavailable, invalid, or nested tools accurately and exposes tool namespaces in the format expected by chat providers.
required.day1_tell: Configure valid, unavailable, invalid, and nested tools, then confirm the UI/API reports availability accurately and sends provider-compatible tool namespaces.

required.what: Builds and packages releases correctly across Windows, Linux, aarch64, archive layouts, runfiles, and target environments.
required.day1_tell: Build release artifacts for Windows, Linux, and aarch64, unpack each archive, and confirm expected layout, runfiles, executable bits, and startup behavior.

required.what: Routes cloud, telemetry, app-server, and provider API traffic to the intended endpoints after infrastructure or upstream changes.
required.day1_tell: Capture outbound requests for cloud, telemetry, app-server, and provider API calls, then confirm each goes to the configured intended endpoint.

required.what: Keeps provider harnesses, native chat harnesses, browser harnesses, and test doubles aligned with upstream protocol and SDK behavior.
required.day1_tell: Run provider, native chat, browser, and fake-provider harnesses against current SDK/protocol fixtures, then confirm all handshake and stream assertions pass.

required.what: Reads and applies existing user, auto-review, approval, model, and editor settings across schema or protocol changes.
required.day1_tell: Load an older user config containing approval, auto-review, model, and editor settings, then confirm all settings are preserved and applied after migration.

required.what: Keeps README grammar, help usage, FAQ figures, and generated model documentation consistent with actual behavior.
required.day1_tell: Generate help, README model docs, and FAQ snippets, then compare commands, options, model names, and figures against the running product behavior.

optional.what: Maps provider, transport, and application errors into known exception classes without false positives or missing error types.
optional.day1_tell: Inject representative provider 400/401/429/500 errors, transport timeouts, and app validation failures, then confirm each maps to the expected exception class.

optional.what: Rejects malformed model paths, whitespace-only elicitation IDs, unsafe edited-message paths, and invalid batch model overrides.
optional.day1_tell: Submit malformed model paths, whitespace-only elicitation IDs, unsafe edited-message paths, and invalid batch model overrides, then confirm each is rejected.

optional.what: Keeps chat UI state, selected models, busy indicators, queued messages, placeholders, and conversation lists synchronized.
optional.day1_tell: In the web UI, switch models while sending queued messages and refreshing the conversation list, then confirm selected model, busy state, placeholders, and list state remain consistent.

optional.what: Provides accessible keyboard behavior and usable mobile ergonomics for selection, escape, composer, and confirmation flows.
optional.day1_tell: Use only keyboard and then a mobile viewport to select, escape, compose, and confirm actions, then confirm all flows are reachable and usable.

optional.what: Maintains sandbox permissions, stdio behavior, execution-server output retention, and platform-specific command execution semantics.
optional.day1_tell: Run a sandboxed command that writes stdout/stderr, attempts denied filesystem access, and uses platform-specific shell syntax, then confirm permissions and retained output are correct.

optional.what: Runs autoupdate, installer, version-check, and update-command flows with locking and correct telemetry or routing behavior.
optional.day1_tell: Run version check, autoupdate, installer, and update command concurrently, then confirm locking prevents races and telemetry/routing events are correct.

optional.what: Displays commit, undo, clear, and co-author history information in a concise and correct form.
optional.day1_tell: Create commits, undo one change, clear history, and add a co-author, then confirm the displayed history is concise and factually correct.

optional.what: Connects to browser automation targets using stable tab or CDP behavior instead of disruptive window/session handling.
optional.day1_tell: Connect browser automation to an existing browser with multiple tabs, then confirm it attaches to the intended tab via stable CDP behavior without opening or stealing windows.

optional.what: Pins automated repair logs to the triggering run and can open structured draft fix PRs from passing gates.
optional.day1_tell: Trigger a failing CI run followed by automated repair, then confirm repair logs link to that run and a structured draft PR opens only after gates pass.
